verdict.rationale: BVNK exposes a rules API (POST /payment/v1/rules) that automates fiat-to-crypto transfers without manual intervention, plus webhooks for real-time automated notifications, showing some background automation capability. However, there's no evidence of a broader automation/workflow engine, scheduling, or explicit support for AI agents orchestrating multi-step autonomous processes. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow builder, evidence of AI-agent-triggered automations, and confirmation that rules run persistently without re-triggering per transaction.
